Version 1.2
OKAY I *FINALLY* MANAGED TO MAKE IT WORK

I forgot yet some other problems with CORS policy and such, so i had to refactor a bit of code to actually make it work.
No big deal, but a little annoying nevertheless

New functionalities :
 - The thing finally works
 - New event : onUpdate
 - Example on my github pages website (https://mizkyosia.github.io/ColorPicker)
 - Script now hosted on github pages, so bye-bye crossorigin problems
 - ColorRect and ColorPreview elements can now be resized without any impact on the colorPicker's functionalities
 - The entire style of the picker is customizable without any impact on the picker's performance or such, meaning you can restyle it however you want and the picker won't stop functioning because of that.
1.1 Now the picker actually works (fixed cross-origin issues)

Version 1.0
Changes :
 - JS and MD documentation for the code
 - HSL support
 - Troubleshooting for color values exceeding the normal limitations after a series of inputs
 - Apply and Cancel buttons added, with their respective `onApply` and `onCancel` events
 - ColorPicker is now a class instead of a bunch of functions, so that it doesn't take up variable names
 - Some utility function outside of the ColorPicker class, like `offset(element)`, `clamp(value,min,max)` and `randomBetween(max,min=0)`

Prototype

Full HEX, RGB and HSV support. Just a prototype for the moment.
